title: Configure Shiki line highlighting
description: Configure Shiki transformers for line range highlighting in code blocks (e.g., highlighting lines 5-10 with {3-5} notation).
design: In vite.config.mjs, add @shikijs/transformers with transformerNotationHighlight. Test with code blocks using {lineNumbers} syntax. Apply highlight CSS class styling.
acceptance_criteria: Code blocks with {3-5} notation highlight specified lines. Highlighting visible in both light and dark modes. No build errors.

title: Phase 4: User Story 5 - Author Adds New Post
description: Author workflow: A content author creates a new blog post by adding a file to the repository with valid frontmatter, and the build system generates the page correctly. Priority P1 - MVP scope.

title: Phase 6: User Story 3 - Search for Content
description: Search functionality: A visitor can quickly find specific topics or posts using client-side fuzzy search with instant results. Search index built at build time using Fuse.js. Priority P2.

title: Configure image handling for co-located assets
description: Configure Vite to handle images and assets co-located with MDX files in blog/ directories, ensuring they are correctly processed and output in the build.
design: Update vite.config.mjs to include blog/ in asset handling. Configure vite-plugin-image-optimizer for WebP/AVIF conversion. Configure vite-plugin-imagetools for responsive srcset. Ensure relative image paths in MDX resolve correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Images in blog/[slug]/ directories are processed during build. Images appear in dist/ with optimized formats. Relative paths like ./image.png work in MDX.

title: Implement auto-excerpt generation
description: When excerpt is not provided in frontmatter, automatically generate it from the first paragraph of the MDX content.
design: In prerender script or remark plugin, detect missing excerpt field. Extract first paragraph text (strip markdown formatting). Truncate to ~160 characters for SEO. Store as excerpt in post metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Posts without excerpt frontmatter get auto-generated excerpt. Excerpt appears in post metadata and SEO meta tags. Excerpt is plain text (no markdown).

title: Create useScrollSpy hook
description: Create a React hook that uses Intersection Observer to track which section heading is currently visible in the viewport for TOC highlighting.
design: Create src/blog/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts. Takes array of heading IDs. Returns currently active ID. Use Intersection Observer with rootMargin to trigger slightly before heading reaches viewport top. Debounce if needed for performance.
acceptance_criteria: Hook correctly identifies active section while scrolling. Updates within 50ms of section change (per SC-005). Works with both h2 and h3 headings.

title: Create blog directory structure
description: Create the source code directory structure for the blog subsystem as defined in plan.md: src/blog/ with components/, hooks/, and utils/ subdirectories.
design: Create: src/blog/index.tsx, src/blog/components/, src/blog/hooks/, src/blog/utils/, src/blog/types.ts. Also create blog/ content directory at repo root.
acceptance_criteria: All directories exist. TypeScript files can be created in src/blog/. Content files can be created in blog/.

title: Phase 9: Polish & Cross-Cutting Concerns
description: Final polish: Accessibility, performance optimization, 404 handling, and validation against success criteria. Improvements affecting multiple user stories.

title: Install MDX pipeline plugins
description: Install remark and rehype plugins for the MDX processing pipeline: frontmatter parsing, reading time calculation, heading IDs, and TOC extraction.
design: Packages: remark-frontmatter, remark-mdx-frontmatter, remark-reading-time, rehype-slug, rehype-autolink-headings, @stefanprobst/rehype-extract-toc
acceptance_criteria: All packages installed. Can import in vite.config.mjs without errors.

title: Create useSearch hook
description: Create a React hook that wraps Fuse.js for fuzzy search with debounced input and instant results.
design: Create src/blog/hooks/useSearch.ts. Lazy-load search-index.json on first search. Initialize Fuse with appropriate keys and weights (title high, excerpt/tags medium, content low). Debounce search input (~150ms). Return search results with highlighted matches.
acceptance_criteria: Hook loads search index on demand. Returns results within 100ms (per SC-002). Results include highlighted match snippets. Works with empty query (returns empty array).

title: Create SearchBar component
description: Create the search input component for the blog index with instant results display as user types.
design: Create src/blog/components/SearchBar.tsx. Input field with search icon. Use useSearch hook. Display results in dropdown or inline list. Show post title, excerpt with highlighted match, and date. Include 'no results' message with suggestions.
acceptance_criteria: Search input renders on blog index. Results appear as user types. Results show title and highlighted excerpt. No results shows helpful message.

title: Create styled 404 page for blog
description: Create a styled 404 page for non-existent blog slugs with navigation back to blog index.
design: Create src/blog/components/NotFound.tsx. Display friendly 404 message, link to blog index, search suggestion. Generate dist/blog/404.html. Configure server to serve this for unknown blog routes.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /blog/nonexistent shows styled 404. Page has link back to blog index. Matches blog design.

title: Phase 8: User Story 4 - Browse All Posts
description: Blog index: A visitor can see all available blog content at /blog with posts sorted by publication date (newest first), showing title, date, excerpt, tags, and reading time. Priority P3.

title: Integrate blog build with main build
description: Ensure pnpm run build generates both landing page and blog static files in a single command.
design: Update package.json build script to run prerender-blog after Vite build. Verify dist/ contains both landing page files and blog/ subdirectory. Update any deployment scripts if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Single pnpm run build command produces complete dist/ with landing page AND blog. No manual steps required. Build time reasonable.

title: Generate SEO meta tags from frontmatter
description: Generate proper meta tags (title, description, Open Graph) in the HTML output from post frontmatter for SEO and social sharing.
design: In prerender HTML template, include: title tag, meta description, og:title, og:description, og:type (article), og:url. Use frontmatter title and excerpt. Consider adding og:image if post has featured image.
acceptance_criteria: Generated HTML has complete meta tags. Title shows in browser tab. Social sharing preview shows title and description.

title: Create SeriesNav component
description: Create the series navigation MDX component that authors can embed in posts to show all parts of a multi-part series with the current post highlighted.
design: Create src/blog/components/SeriesNav.tsx. Props: series (string identifier), parts (array of {slug, title}), current (string slug). Render as ordered list or card grid showing all parts. Highlight current part. Link to other parts. Style consistent with blog design.
acceptance_criteria: SeriesNav renders list of all series parts. Current part is visually highlighted. Clicking another part navigates to that post. Component works in MDX content.

title: Phase 5: User Story 2 - Browse Blog by Tags
description: Tag filtering: A visitor explores related content by filtering posts based on topics of interest using tag chips on the blog index. Inline filtering with URL hash for shareability. Priority P2.

title: Install Shiki syntax highlighting
description: Install Shiki and its rehype integration for build-time syntax highlighting with VS Code-quality tokenization.
design: Packages: shiki, @shikijs/rehype, @shikijs/transformers. Transformers enable line highlighting notation.
acceptance_criteria: Packages installed. Shiki can be imported and themes loaded.

title: Run quickstart.md validation
description: Validate the quickstart.md documentation by following all steps to ensure author workflow is correct and documentation is accurate.
design: Follow quickstart.md step-by-step: create new post, add frontmatter, add images, test code blocks, preview in dev server. Update documentation if steps are incorrect or missing.
acceptance_criteria: New author can follow quickstart.md to create first post. All documented features work as described. Time to publish < 5 minutes (SC-004).

title: Static MDX Blog
description: Add a static MDX blog to the TerraConstructs website with build-time generation, tag-based navigation, floating TOC with scroll tracking, and client-side fuzzy search. The blog is a separate subsystem from the landing page, using React 19 for MDX support while maintaining vanilla JS isolation for the main site through Vite code splitting. See specs/001-static-mdx-blog/ for full specification.

title: Create theme utilities for dark mode
description: Create shared theme utilities for dark mode integration between blog components and landing page theme state.
design: Create src/blog/utils/theme.ts. Export functions: getTheme() reads localStorage 'theme' key, setTheme(theme) updates localStorage and document class, toggleTheme() switches between light/dark. Match landing page main.js implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Theme utilities work in React components. Theme changes persist across page loads. Blog and landing page share same theme state.

title: Configure Vite for blog multi-entry build
description: Update vite.config.mjs to support multi-entry build with React for blog pages while keeping vanilla JS for landing page. Configure MDX plugin with all remark/rehype plugins.
design: Add @vitejs/plugin-react, @mdx-js/rollup with remarkPlugins (frontmatter, mdx-frontmatter, reading-time) and rehypePlugins (slug, autolink-headings, shiki). Configure build.rollupOptions.input for multi-entry. Ensure code-splitting separates blog bundle from main bundle.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm run build produces separate bundles: main.[hash].js (~50KB) and blog.[hash].js (~100-120KB). Blog code does not load on landing page.

title: Create BlogLayout component
description: Create the shared layout wrapper for all blog pages including header navigation, footer, and overall page structure. Integrates with landing page theme toggle.
design: Create src/blog/components/BlogLayout.tsx. Include: header with nav links (Home, Blog), theme toggle button that syncs with landing page localStorage, footer matching landing page style. Use Tailwind classes consistent with landing page (Inter font, ink/paper colors).
acceptance_criteria: Layout renders with header/footer. Theme toggle works and persists to localStorage. Navigation links work. Matches landing page visual style.

title: Create PostPage component
description: Create the main post page component that renders a single blog post with article content, TOC, metadata (title, date, author, reading time), and proper layout.
design: Create src/blog/components/PostPage.tsx. Integrate: BlogLayout wrapper, TOC/TOCDrawer (responsive), useScrollSpy, CodeBlock for code. Display title as h1, author byline, date, reading time. Render MDX content with custom component mappings.
acceptance_criteria: Post renders with all content. Metadata displays correctly. TOC shows on desktop, drawer on mobile. Code blocks have syntax highlighting. Reading time shows. Author byline displays.

title: Create custom Shiki theme matching landing page
description: Create a custom Shiki theme JSON that matches the existing landing page syntax highlighting colors (both light and dark modes) for visual consistency.
design: Create src/blog/shiki-theme.json (or two files for light/dark). Map existing highlight.js token colors to Shiki TextMate scopes. Test with TypeScript, Go, Python, HCL code samples from demos/.
acceptance_criteria: Code blocks in blog posts match the landing page code highlighting. Both light and dark modes work. No visual jarring when navigating between landing page and blog.

title: Create TagFilter component
description: Create the tag filter UI component that displays all available tags as clickable chips and filters the post list when selected.
design: Create src/blog/components/TagFilter.tsx. Props: tags (Tag[]), activeTag (string | null), onTagSelect (function). Render tags as horizontal scrollable chip list. Highlight active tag. Include 'All' option to clear filter. Style consistent with landing page badges.
acceptance_criteria: All tags display as clickable chips. Clicking tag calls onTagSelect. Active tag is visually highlighted. 'All' option clears selection.

title: Phase 1: Setup
description: Project initialization and shared infrastructure setup for the blog subsystem. Installs new dependencies (React 19, MDX, Shiki, Fuse.js), configures Vite for multi-entry build, and establishes the blog directory structure.

title: Add clickable tags to PostCard
description: Display all tags on post cards in listings and make them clickable to trigger tag filtering. Note: Depends on PostCard from US4, but can stub PostCard if implementing in parallel.
design: In PostCard component (created in US4), display tags array as small clickable chips. onClick navigates to blog index with tag hash. Style tags consistently with TagFilter chips.
acceptance_criteria: Post cards show all associated tags. Clicking a tag navigates to filtered blog index. Tags are visually consistent across components.

title: Phase 2: Foundational
description: Core infrastructure that MUST be complete before ANY user story can be implemented. Includes prerender script, custom Shiki theme, and shared layout components.

title: Create TOC component for desktop
description: Create the floating table of contents component for desktop viewports (>=768px) that displays article headings and highlights the currently visible section.
design: Create src/blog/components/TOC.tsx. Props: entries (TOCEntry[]), activeId (string). Render h2/h3 hierarchy with nested indentation. Sticky position on right side of article. Highlight active heading. Smooth scroll on click.
acceptance_criteria: TOC displays on desktop viewports. Shows h2/h3 hierarchy. Active section highlights based on scroll position. Clicking heading scrolls to that section.

title: Create BlogIndex page component
description: Create the main blog index page at /blog that combines SearchBar, TagFilter, and PostList components.
design: Create src/blog/components/BlogIndex.tsx. Integrate: BlogLayout wrapper, SearchBar, TagFilter, PostList. Manage state for active tag filter and search results. Handle URL hash for tag filter. Title as h1.
acceptance_criteria: Blog index page renders at /blog. Search, tag filter, and post list all functional. Layout responsive. SEO meta tags present.

title: Create sample blog post for testing
description: Create a sample blog post in blog/getting-started/index.mdx with valid frontmatter and content for testing the build pipeline.
design: Create blog/getting-started/index.mdx with frontmatter (title, date, author, tags, excerpt) and sample content including h2/h3 headings and a code block. Add a sample image to test co-located assets.
acceptance_criteria: MDX file parses without errors. Frontmatter exports correctly. Build succeeds with sample post.

title: Implement frontmatter validation
description: Add validation logic to the prerender script that fails the build with clear error messages when frontmatter is invalid per data-model.md requirements.
design: In prerender script, validate: 1) Required fields exist (title, date, author), 2) Date is valid ISO 8601, 3) No duplicate slugs, 4) Tags are lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens. Exit with code 1 and clear error message on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Build fails with descriptive error for: missing title, invalid date format, duplicate slugs, invalid tag format. Error message includes filename and specific issue.

title: Add development HMR for blog content
description: Configure Vite dev server to support hot module replacement for blog MDX files so authors can preview changes instantly.
design: Ensure @mdx-js/rollup HMR is enabled. Configure Vite server to watch blog/ directory. Test that editing MDX content updates the browser without full reload.
acceptance_criteria: Editing MDX files triggers hot reload. Changes appear in browser within seconds. No full page refresh needed for content changes.

title: Phase 7: User Story 6 - Navigate Multi-Part Series
description: Series navigation: A visitor reading part of a series can navigate to other parts without returning to the blog index via an in-post SeriesNav component. Priority P2.

title: Create PostCard component
description: Create the post preview card component used in blog listings showing title, date, excerpt, tags, and reading time.
design: Create src/blog/components/PostCard.tsx. Props: post (PostCard type from data-model). Display title as h2/h3, date formatted, excerpt truncated, tags as chips, reading time. Link entire card to post URL. Style with Tailwind, hover states, responsive.
acceptance_criteria: PostCard renders all metadata fields. Card links to post. Tags are clickable (integrate with US2). Responsive layout works at all breakpoints.

title: Validate success criteria
description: Run validation tests against all success criteria from spec.md to ensure feature meets requirements.
design: Test each SC: SC-001 (2s load on 3G), SC-002 (search <100ms), SC-003 (accessibility), SC-004 (publish <5min), SC-005 (TOC update <50ms), SC-006 (100+ posts), SC-007 (Lighthouse >=90). Document results.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 success criteria pass. Documentation of test methodology and results. Any failures addressed or documented as known issues.

title: Integrate prerender with PostPage for static generation
description: Update the prerender script to use PostPage component for rendering individual blog posts to static HTML.
design: In prerender script, for each MDX file: import the MDX content and metadata, render PostPage with data using ReactDOMServer.renderToString, write complete HTML document with proper head tags (title, description, OG meta). Ensure hydration script is included for interactive features.
acceptance_criteria: Running prerender generates complete HTML pages at dist/blog/[slug]/index.html. Pages include proper meta tags from frontmatter. TOC and code copy features work after hydration.

title: Register SeriesNav as MDX component
description: Configure the MDX pipeline to make SeriesNav available as a component in MDX files without requiring explicit imports.
design: In MDX provider or prerender setup, register SeriesNav in the components mapping. Authors can use <SeriesNav .../> directly in MDX without import statement. Document usage in quickstart.md.
acceptance_criteria: SeriesNav works in MDX files without import. Build succeeds with SeriesNav usage. Component receives props correctly.

title: Aggregate tags from all posts
description: Compute unique tags with post counts from all blog posts during the prerender build process for the TagFilter component.
design: In prerender script, after loading all posts: collect all tags, count occurrences, create Tag[] array with name, slug, count. Export as JSON or embed in blog index HTML for client hydration.
acceptance_criteria: Tag list includes all unique tags from all posts. Each tag has correct post count. Tags sorted alphabetically or by count.

title: Performance optimization and bundle analysis
description: Analyze and optimize bundle size to meet the ~100-120KB blog bundle target (SC-001). Ensure lazy loading where appropriate.
design: Run pnpm build with bundle analysis. Verify blog bundle is code-split from main. Check React + dependencies < 120KB gzipped. Lazy-load search index. Tree-shake unused code.
acceptance_criteria: Blog bundle < 120KB gzipped. Search index lazy-loaded. Main landing page does NOT load React. Lighthouse performance score >= 90.

title: Phase 3: User Story 1 - Read a Blog Post
description: Core reading experience: A visitor discovers a TerraConstructs blog post through search or direct link and reads it with proper formatting, syntax highlighting, and navigation aids (TOC). Priority P1 - MVP scope.

title: Implement URL hash sync for tag filter
description: Sync the active tag filter with the URL hash (e.g., /blog#tag=aws) for shareability and browser history support.
design: On page load, read window.location.hash and parse tag parameter. Update hash when tag is selected. Listen for hashchange events. Use history.replaceState to avoid cluttering history.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting a tag updates URL hash. Sharing URL with hash loads with that tag filtered. Browser back/forward navigates filter history.

title: Create PostList component
description: Create the blog index listing component that displays all posts in a grid or list layout, sorted by date.
design: Create src/blog/components/PostList.tsx. Props: posts (PostCard[]), filteredTag (string | null for tag filtering). Render PostCards in responsive grid (1 col mobile, 2-3 cols desktop). Sort by date descending. Filter by tag if provided.
acceptance_criteria: PostList renders all posts in grid. Posts sorted newest first. Responsive grid layout. Works with tag filtering from US2.

title: Install image optimization plugins
description: Install vite-plugin-image-optimizer for global compression and vite-plugin-imagetools for responsive image variants.
design: Packages: vite-plugin-image-optimizer, vite-plugin-imagetools. Optimizer handles WebP/AVIF conversion, imagetools handles ?w=400 query syntax.
acceptance_criteria: Both packages installed. Can add to vite.config.mjs plugins array.

title: Handle search unavailable gracefully
description: Implement graceful degradation when search index fails to load or is unavailable.
design: In useSearch hook, catch fetch errors. Return error state. In SearchBar, show 'search unavailable' message when error. Consider hiding search UI entirely if index missing.
acceptance_criteria: If search-index.json fails to load, UI shows 'search unavailable' message. Page remains functional. No console errors or crashes.

title: Create TypeScript type definitions
description: Create the TypeScript interfaces for blog entities as defined in data-model.md: Post, TOCEntry, Tag, SearchIndexEntry, PostCard, Frontmatter.
design: Create src/blog/types.ts with all interfaces. Include MDX module augmentation for frontmatter/toc/readingTime exports. Reference data-model.md for exact field definitions.
acceptance_criteria: Types compile without errors. Can import types in other blog files. MDX imports are properly typed.

title: Install Fuse.js for client-side search
description: Install Fuse.js library for fuzzy search functionality on the blog index page.
design: Package: fuse.js (~7KB gzipped). Lightweight, no dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: fuse.js installed. Can import and instantiate Fuse in a test file.

title: Generate blog index static HTML
description: Update prerender script to generate the static blog index page at dist/blog/index.html with all post metadata embedded.
design: In prerender script, collect all PostCard data from posts. Render BlogIndex component with ReactDOMServer. Embed post data as JSON in script tag for hydration. Generate dist/blog/index.html.
acceptance_criteria: dist/blog/index.html generated with all posts. Page hydrates correctly for interactivity. Search and tag filter work after hydration.

title: Generate search index JSON at build time
description: Create the search index generation step in the prerender script that outputs a JSON file for Fuse.js client-side search.
design: In prerender script, create SearchIndexEntry[] from all posts: slug, title (high weight), excerpt (medium), tags (medium), content as plain text (low weight). Write to dist/search-index.json. Keep content field lean - strip markdown, limit length.
acceptance_criteria: dist/search-index.json generated with all posts. File size reasonable (<50KB for 20 posts). Contains all searchable fields.

title: Create TOCDrawer component for mobile
description: Create the collapsible table of contents drawer for mobile viewports (<768px), hidden by default with an expand button.
design: Create src/blog/components/TOCDrawer.tsx. Props: entries (TOCEntry[]), activeId (string), isOpen (boolean), onToggle (function). Slide-in drawer from bottom or side. Toggle button visible in mobile view. Same functionality as TOC but in drawer format.
acceptance_criteria: TOC drawer hidden by default on mobile. Toggle button visible. Drawer opens/closes smoothly. Clicking heading scrolls and closes drawer.

title: Accessibility audit and fixes
description: Run accessibility audit on all blog pages and fix any WCAG 2.1 AA violations per SC-003.
design: Use axe-core or Lighthouse accessibility audit. Check: semantic HTML, ARIA labels, focus management, color contrast, keyboard navigation. Fix all violations. Test with screen reader.
acceptance_criteria: 100% of blog pages pass WCAG 2.1 AA audit. No accessibility errors in Lighthouse. Keyboard navigation works throughout.

title: Create prerender script for static HTML generation
description: Create the custom prerender script that generates static HTML pages for all blog posts and the blog index. This is the core SSG mechanism per research.md Decision 1.
design: Create scripts/prerender-blog.mjs (~100 lines). Script should: 1) Glob blog/*/index.mdx files, 2) Import each MDX module, 3) Render to HTML with React, 4) Write dist/blog/[slug]/index.html, 5) Generate dist/blog/index.html listing. Use Vite build API. Add pnpm script 'build:blog' to package.json.
acceptance_criteria: Running pnpm build:blog generates static HTML for all posts. HTML files are complete (not partial React hydration roots). Build time <10s for 10 posts.

title: Install React and MDX dependencies
description: Install core dependencies for the blog subsystem: react, react-dom, @mdx-js/rollup, @vitejs/plugin-react. These are required for MDX compilation and React rendering.
design: Add to package.json devDependencies. Run pnpm install. Packages: react@19, react-dom@19, @vitejs/plugin-react@latest, @mdx-js/rollup@latest
acceptance_criteria: All packages installed. pnpm install succeeds. No peer dependency warnings.

title: Create CodeBlock component with copy button
description: Create the CodeBlock component that wraps Shiki-highlighted code with interactive features: copy-to-clipboard button and expandable/collapsible sections for long code.
design: Create src/blog/components/CodeBlock.tsx. Props: children (pre-highlighted HTML from Shiki), collapsed (boolean for initially collapsed). Include copy button with clipboard API, expand/collapse toggle for long blocks. Style with Tailwind matching landing page code blocks.
acceptance_criteria: Code blocks render with syntax highlighting. Copy button copies code to clipboard with visual feedback. Collapsed blocks can be expanded. Works in both light and dark mode.
